reviewer: Codex, passive saved-trajectory and host-evidence review
reason: The model exhausted 80 calls on file browsing and editor navigation without entering or starting a UART implementation. The host received no serial replies and awarded 0/10. The final Find/Replace form received the host cleanup commands as field text rather than executing them in a shell.

errors.guest_observations: Nonexistent C:/ paths caused ExceptDrv; attempted writes to read-only T:/Kernel files caused BlkWrite/DocWrite exceptions.

mechanism_observations: No model action defines BenchStart/BenchStop, configures the UART, installs an interrupt handler, or enters a worker/parser implementation. Telemetry.HC is visibly empty at turn 51.
IntEntrySet and IRET appear as bare editor-search text, not an installed handler or compiled interrupt code.
All eight protocol cases received zero replies. The IRQ4 dependence probe was skipped because no functional serial case passed.
Host cleanup text landed in the Find/Replace form; no BenchStop execution or fresh shell output was verified. Readable hardware remained in its initial state.
limitations: This records failure to produce a working service in this screenshot-only episode; it does not measure the correctness of an implemented driver.
Unchanged hardware and silence do not earn cleanup or interrupt-dependence credit.
The shell challenge failed in the final editor form; this does not establish a kernel hang or global desktop failure.
